limits: Only fifty pairs acquired and k was not swept.
One lambda, one model family, one resource.
The evaluation set is fixed while training grows, so the estimand is the change in a fixed ranking task.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim.

the_answer.question: at equal budget, does uncertainty-based pair selection beat random pair selection
the_answer.reading: the point estimate is slightly negative and the interval spans zero. Uncertainty-based acquisition buys nothing over random selection at this granularity.

how_strong_this_negative_is.can_rule_out: an advantage larger than about 0.014 in the gain
how_strong_this_negative_is.cannot_rule_out: a positive advantage smaller than that
how_strong_this_negative_is.so: the honest statement is that no advantage is detectable at this sample size and budget, not that an advantage provably does not exist
how_strong_this_negative_is.count: this is the same caution I had to apply in R182 and R183, in the other direction

why_the_negative_is_expected_in_hindsigh.observation: adding about 1,835 rows (fifty whole pairs) moved the gain by at most 0.003 in either arm
why_the_negative_is_expected_in_hindsigh.meaning: the quantity is already saturated with respect to this kind of data
why_the_negative_is_expected_in_hindsigh.so: if more data of this kind barely changes the estimate, then choosing WHICH data to add can barely help either. Selection accelerates learning; it cannot help a learning curve that has already flattened
why_the_negative_is_expected_in_hindsigh.consistency: this lines up with C129 and C144, where the gain was flat across a twenty-nine-fold change in training size and insensitive to how the budget was allocated

this_closes_the_active_learning_thread_p.earlier_failures: cell-level disagreement sampling, which R174 later showed was structurally doomed because the model gives every cell of a pair the same prediction
this_closes_the_active_learning_thread_p.this_test: pair-level uncertainty acquisition, the granularity where the model genuinely discriminates
this_closes_the_active_learning_thread_p.outcome: still no advantage, and now for a reason that is not an artefact of the granularity: the estimate is saturated
this_closes_the_active_learning_thread_p.so: the Agent-selects-minimal-evidence half of the objective has no remaining untested formulation in this resource that I can see
